standard-dialogue.npc: Psst! Got any Void kit you don't want? Spare robes, spare helms, that kind of thing?

steps.npc: Might be able to take it off your hands for you. Show me what you've got, and I'll see if I can get you some Commendation Points for it.

steps.text: If the player does not have any eligible items:
If the player has any non-broken void items:
The player will offer whatever item is closest to the bottom-right corner of their inventory.
If the item selected is a Void mage helm:
You show the squire some of your Void kit.
If the value of the item puts the player over the maximum amount of Void knight commendation points:
Void mage helm: The squire offers you [0-160] Commendation points.

steps.prompt: Void mage helm: Exchange for [0-160] points?

steps.text: their Void mage helm to the Dodgy Squire
